Learning Rust

Mar 13, 2022

I have thought of learning a new programming language. After googling for a while. i decided to start learning rust. In this post, I’ll introduce you to the main concepts of programming in the rust language.

Rust is basically a general purpose language that was built with performance and safety in mind. Rust boasts of safe concurrency and has its syntax similar to C++.

Rust’s key feature: Memory safety.
